name: Patrick Pynadath
title: PhD Student @ Purdue University
bio: I am a PhD student at Purdue University, studying machine learning under the guidance of Professor Ruqi Zhang. I am broadly interested in probabilistic machine learning methodologies, with a current focus on diffusion language models (DLMs).
My research interests include diffusion language models, Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC), large language models, generative modeling, and controlled generation.
I work with PyTorch, PyTorch Lightning, Hydra, Slurm, TensorFlow, NumPy, Matplotlib, BeautifulSoup, and Hugging Face Transformers.
